name: Hour of Devastation
description: Catastrophe unleashed on Naktamun by Nicol Bolas.

description_citations.text: "Oketra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas's return in the Hour of Devastation kills most of the gods, leaving Hazoret, the Scarab God and the Locust God.
timeline.quote: After Bolas's return to the plane during the Hour of Devastation , the majority of the gods were killed.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Amonkhet's angels join the God-Pharaoh's hordes in laying waste to the plane during the Hour of Devastation.
timeline.quote: their true loyalty to the God-Pharaoh came to light, as they joined his hordes in laying waste to the plane

citation.text: "Angel", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Hour of Devastation elementals rise from burning rock, the Luxa River and the desert to turn on Naktamun and reduce it to rubble.
timeline.quote: elementals arose from burning rock, the blood-tainted waters of the Luxa River, and the sands of the desert itself to turn on Naktamun and reduce it to rubble

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Hour of Devastation, Bolas's Eternal army destroys Naktamun and slays most of its gods; the survivors under Hazoret flee.
timeline.quote: the city was destroyed by the Eternal army of Nicol Bolas, and most of its gods were slain
